conditions.script:
dis_country = frappe.db.get_value("Distributor", {"user_id": user}, "country")

conditions = f"""EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM `tabOption Country` child
        WHERE child.parent = `tabLMS Course`.name  AND
        child.country = '{dis_country}'
    )
    AND 
 custom_assigned_to_role IN ('Distributor', 'All')
"""

emp_country = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", {"user_id": user}, "country")

conditions = f"""EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM `tabOption Country` child
        WHERE child.parent = `tabLMS Course`.name  AND
        child.country = '{emp_country}'
    )
    AND 
 custom_assigned_to_role IN ('Employee', 'All')
"""

description: LMS Course Access According Country and Roles
name: LMS Course Access
title: LMS Course Access
